name: Sakamichi
source:
Nakazawa Saito goes by train to his very last journey. Suddenly he sees sleepy, but talkative girl, who offers him a company on the journey to the north. The story about two young people who lost their paths of life. Are they able to return to the crossroads, if the destiny connects their paths together?

Authors: Inoue Yuki, Rikka, Ikeuchi Yusuke, Yamanaka Masashi, Sai Gakai + other extern members
translation:
中泽斋藤乘坐火车踏上最后一次旅程。突然，他看见一名困倦却健谈的女孩，女孩提出陪他一起前往北方。这是两个迷失人生方向的年轻人的故事。如果命运让他们的道路交汇，他们能回到人生的十字路口吗？

作者：Inoue Yuki、Rikka、Ikeuchi Yusuke、Yamanaka Masashi、Sai Gakai及其他外部成员。
